topics.name: Identity Reset and Merit Boundary
topics.purpose: Define that creating/resetting to a new IdentityCore identity starts a separate MeritCore timeline and cannot be used to merge or sanitize an existing merit history.

semantics.new_identity_rule: New canonical identity has a new independent merit timeline.
semantics.merge_rule: Prior merits/points/Tier/recommendations/trust do not transfer by default.
semantics.negative_rule: Negative evidence cannot be escaped while retaining positive history through identity merge.
semantics.positive_rule: Reset forfeits previous positive MeritCore history unless a future explicit identity-continuity contract is created.
semantics.portfolio_rule: Shared external work may be re-referenced only through new explicit evidence, never history merge.
semantics.audit_rule: Identity lifecycle remains traceable according to privacy/governance.
semantics.authority_rule: Reset semantics are MeritCore integrity, not AccessCore.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.
